name: Lazy People
overview: Scripture clearly condemns laziness as a rejection of wise instruction and a cause of shame and poverty. The psalmist highlights that lazy people hate instruction and disregard God's words, while Proverbs urges the sluggard to learn from the ant’s diligence and warns against prolonged idleness. The diligent are promised prosperity and leadership, whereas the slothful face shame and subjugation, emphasizing the biblical call to diligence as a reflection of godly wisdom and responsibility.
